rawContent: @DonovanSClifton I'm imagining you haven't had any problems since you have not acted unprofessionally. 😀 My husband works in an office. He doesn't worry. Walking up to a woman and worrying about being accused of rape is not a legitimate fear. It does de-legitimize the #metoo movement.

The people saying the #metoo movement makes men worried about the remote potential that someone would mistake flirtation w/sexual assault. I ask how much should I concern myself with your fear of the potential to what women experience?
